name: 郵輪與旅遊實用
topic: 郵輪船上生活、岸上觀光、旅行物品與日常口語(B2)

cards.example: We embark at three, so let's get to the terminal by noon.
cards.exampleZh: 我們三點登船,所以中午前要到碼頭。

cards.example: Passengers will disembark through deck four.
cards.exampleZh: 乘客將從四號甲板下船。

cards.example: Keep your boarding pass handy at the gangway.
cards.exampleZh: 在登船梯那邊把登船證拿在手上。

cards.example: Check-in opens two hours before departure.
cards.exampleZh: 出發前兩小時開始辦理報到。

cards.example: The itinerary lists three ports over seven days.
cards.exampleZh: 行程表列出七天內停靠三個港口。

cards.example: The muster drill is mandatory for everyone on board.
cards.exampleZh: 救生演習船上所有人都必須參加。

cards.example: Mind your step on the gangway.
cards.exampleZh: 走舷梯時小心腳步。

cards.example: The cruise terminal is packed this morning.
cards.exampleZh: 今天早上郵輪航廈擠滿了人。

cards.example: Departure has been pushed back an hour.
cards.exampleZh: 啟航時間往後延了一小時。

cards.example: Make sure your passport is still valid.
cards.exampleZh: 確認你的護照還在有效期內。

cards.example: My visa expires next month.
cards.exampleZh: 我的簽證下個月到期。

cards.example: They stamped my passport at immigration.
cards.exampleZh: 他們在入境處幫我的護照蓋章。

cards.example: The immigration line moved surprisingly fast.
cards.exampleZh: 入境隊伍前進得意外地快。

cards.example: You have to go through customs before leaving the port.
cards.exampleZh: 離開港口前要先過海關。

cards.example: Do you have anything to declare?
cards.exampleZh: 你有東西要申報嗎?

cards.example: The crew was friendly the entire trip.
cards.exampleZh: 整趟旅程船員都很友善。

cards.example: Our cabin steward refills the towels every day.
cards.exampleZh: 我們的艙房管家每天補毛巾。

cards.example: There's free Wi-Fi on board, but it's slow.
cards.exampleZh: 船上有免費 Wi-Fi,但很慢。

cards.example: Put your key card on a lanyard so you don't lose it.
cards.exampleZh: 把房卡掛在掛繩上才不會弄丟。

cards.example: The wristband shows you've paid for the drink package.
cards.exampleZh: 手環代表你已經買了飲料方案。

cards.example: Attendance at the safety briefing is mandatory.
cards.exampleZh: 安全說明會是強制參加的。

cards.example: We board at noon and sail at five.
cards.exampleZh: 我們中午登船,五點啟航。

cards.example: The ship departs from pier nine.
cards.exampleZh: 船從九號碼頭出發。

cards.example: Our cabin is on the eighth deck.
cards.exampleZh: 我們的艙房在八樓甲板。

cards.example: We got a free upgrade to a balcony cabin.
cards.exampleZh: 我們免費升等到有陽台的艙房。

cards.example: The stateroom is small but well designed.
cards.exampleZh: 客艙很小但設計得不錯。

cards.example: Waking up on the balcony was worth the extra money.
cards.exampleZh: 在陽台醒來值得多花那些錢。

cards.example: You can barely see anything through the porthole.
cards.exampleZh: 從舷窗幾乎看不到什麼。

cards.example: The kids took the top bunk.
cards.exampleZh: 小孩子搶了上鋪。

cards.example: The thermostat in our room is broken.
cards.exampleZh: 我們房間的溫控器壞了。

cards.example: There's only one outlet next to the bed.
cards.exampleZh: 床邊只有一個插座。

cards.example: Don't forget a universal adapter.
cards.exampleZh: 別忘了帶萬用轉接頭。

cards.example: The cabin comes with a hairdryer.
cards.exampleZh: 艙房附吹風機。

cards.example: Leave your passport in the safe.
cards.exampleZh: 把護照放在保險箱裡。

cards.example: They change the linen every other day.
cards.exampleZh: 他們每隔一天換一次床單。

cards.example: Housekeeping comes by around ten.
cards.exampleZh: 清潔人員大概十點會來。

cards.example: I hung the do not disturb sign on the door.
cards.exampleZh: 我把請勿打擾的牌子掛在門上。

cards.example: The suite was surprisingly spacious.
cards.exampleZh: 那間套房意外地寬敞。

cards.example: The inside cabin felt a bit cramped.
cards.exampleZh: 內艙房感覺有點擠。

cards.example: It gets stuffy without the air conditioning.
cards.exampleZh: 沒開冷氣就變得很悶。

cards.example: The walls aren't exactly soundproof.
cards.exampleZh: 這牆壁其實不太隔音。

cards.example: The cabin amenities include shampoo and lotion.
cards.exampleZh: 艙房備品包含洗髮精和乳液。

cards.example: There's a self-service laundry on deck six.
cards.exampleZh: 六樓甲板有自助洗衣間。

cards.example: Grab a pool towel from the stand.
cards.exampleZh: 從架子上拿條泳池浴巾。

cards.example: Your keycard also works as your onboard payment.
cards.exampleZh: 房卡同時也是船上的付款工具。

cards.example: The buffet opens at six thirty.
cards.exampleZh: 自助餐六點半開始。

cards.example: Gratuities are added automatically to your bill.
cards.exampleZh: 服務費會自動加在帳單上。

cards.example: The beverage package covers soda and coffee.
cards.exampleZh: 飲料方案包含汽水和咖啡。

cards.example: Breakfast is complimentary for suite guests.
cards.exampleZh: 套房房客可享免費早餐。

cards.example: The specialty restaurant is à la carte.
cards.exampleZh: 特色餐廳是單點的。

cards.example: We shared a couple of appetizers.
cards.exampleZh: 我們分著吃了幾道前菜。

cards.example: I'll have the fish as my entrée.
cards.exampleZh: 我主菜要點魚。

cards.example: Save some room for dessert.
cards.exampleZh: 留點肚子吃甜點。

cards.example: Can I get a refill on my coffee?
cards.exampleZh: 可以幫我的咖啡續杯嗎?

cards.example: Let them know about any dietary restrictions.
cards.exampleZh: 有任何飲食限制要跟他們說。

cards.example: I'm allergic to shellfish.
cards.exampleZh: 我對甲殼類過敏。

cards.example: They always have a vegetarian option.
cards.exampleZh: 他們一定會有素食選項。

cards.example: Can I get this as takeaway?
cards.exampleZh: 這個可以外帶嗎?

cards.example: Let's grab a bite before the show.
cards.exampleZh: 看表演前我們隨便吃點東西吧。

cards.example: I'm starving — when does dinner start?
cards.exampleZh: 我快餓死了,晚餐幾點開始?

cards.example: I'm stuffed. I couldn't eat another bite.
cards.exampleZh: 我吃超飽,一口都吃不下了。

cards.example: The soup was a little bland.
cards.exampleZh: 那湯味道有點淡。

cards.example: The fries were too greasy for me.
cards.exampleZh: 那薯條對我來說太油了。

cards.example: I like my bacon crispy.
cards.exampleZh: 我喜歡培根煎得酥脆。

cards.example: We packed up the leftovers.
cards.exampleZh: 我們把剩菜打包了。

cards.example: Does anyone have a bottle opener?
cards.exampleZh: 有人有開瓶器嗎?

cards.example: You'll need a corkscrew for that bottle.
cards.exampleZh: 那瓶酒需要用紅酒開瓶器。

cards.example: Could I get a straw with that?
cards.exampleZh: 可以給我一根吸管嗎?

cards.example: Pass me a napkin, would you?
cards.exampleZh: 可以給我一張餐巾紙嗎?

cards.example: We tipped the waiter at the end.
cards.exampleZh: 最後我們給了服務生小費。

cards.example: The pool is up on deck eleven.
cards.exampleZh: 泳池在十一樓甲板。

cards.example: We walked the promenade after dinner.
cards.exampleZh: 晚餐後我們沿著步道走了走。

cards.example: The band plays in the atrium every night.
cards.exampleZh: 樂團每晚在中庭演出。

cards.example: There's a quiet lounge on the top deck.
cards.exampleZh: 頂層甲板有個安靜的交誼廳。

cards.example: The show moved to a bigger venue.
cards.exampleZh: 表演換到比較大的場地了。

cards.example: Do we need a reservation for the spa?
cards.exampleZh: 做 SPA 需要預約嗎?

cards.example: I booked us a table for seven.
cards.exampleZh: 我訂了七點的位子。

cards.example: Sorry, we're fully booked tonight.
cards.exampleZh: 抱歉,今晚已經訂滿了。

cards.example: They put us on the waitlist.
cards.exampleZh: 他們把我們排進候補名單。

cards.example: The excursion is sold out.
cards.exampleZh: 那個行程已經賣完了。

cards.example: Bring your own yoga mat if you have one.
cards.exampleZh: 如果你有瑜珈墊就自己帶。

cards.example: All the treadmills were taken.
cards.exampleZh: 跑步機全被佔滿了。

cards.example: Leave your stuff in a locker.
cards.exampleZh: 把東西放在置物櫃裡。

cards.example: People reserve sun loungers way too early.
cards.exampleZh: 大家都太早去佔躺椅了。

cards.example: The hot tub was packed all afternoon.
cards.exampleZh: 按摩浴池整個下午都是人。

cards.example: The pool deck gets crowded around noon.
cards.exampleZh: 泳池甲板中午前後會變很擠。

cards.example: The theater was absolutely packed.
cards.exampleZh: 劇院擠得水洩不通。

cards.example: Show up early if you want a good seat.
cards.exampleZh: 想要好位子就早點到。

cards.example: Everyone lined up for the buffet.
cards.exampleZh: 大家都排隊等自助餐。

cards.example: Let's skip the show and go to bed.
cards.exampleZh: 我們跳過表演直接去睡吧。

cards.example: We booked a shore excursion in Okinawa.
cards.exampleZh: 我們在沖繩訂了岸上觀光行程。

cards.example: Our next port of call is Naha.
cards.exampleZh: 我們下一個停靠港是那霸。

cards.example: We take a tender to get ashore.
cards.exampleZh: 我們搭接駁小船上岸。

cards.example: We went ashore for a few hours.
cards.exampleZh: 我們上岸待了幾個小時。

cards.example: All aboard time is four thirty sharp.
cards.exampleZh: 登船截止時間是四點半整。

cards.example: That tower is the city's main landmark.
cards.exampleZh: 那座塔是這城市的主要地標。

cards.example: I picked up a few souvenirs at the market.
cards.exampleZh: 我在市場買了幾樣紀念品。

cards.example: You can bargain a little at that stall.
cards.exampleZh: 那個攤位可以稍微殺價。

cards.example: Forty dollars for that? What a rip-off.
cards.exampleZh: 那個要四十塊?也太坑了吧。

cards.example: I'm just browsing, thanks.
cards.exampleZh: 我只是隨便看看,謝謝。

cards.example: That shop is cash only.
cards.exampleZh: 那家店只收現金。

cards.example: The exchange rate at the port is terrible.
cards.exampleZh: 港口的匯率很差。

cards.example: Let's head out before it gets hot.
cards.exampleZh: 趁天氣還沒熱起來出發吧。

cards.example: We just wandered around the old town.
cards.exampleZh: 我們就在老城區隨意閒逛。

cards.example: We got lost twice looking for the shrine.
cards.exampleZh: 我們找神社的路上迷路兩次。

cards.example: The crowd thinned out after lunch.
cards.exampleZh: 午餐後人潮就少了。

cards.example: The hike was long but totally worth it.
cards.exampleZh: 那段路很長但完全值得。

cards.example: We're running late — the ship leaves at five.
cards.exampleZh: 我們要遲到了,船五點開。

cards.example: Do you think we'll make it back in time?
cards.exampleZh: 你覺得我們來得及趕回去嗎?

cards.example: I get seasick if the water is rough.
cards.exampleZh: 浪大的時候我會暈船。

cards.example: Take something for motion sickness before boarding.
cards.exampleZh: 登船前先吃暈船藥。

cards.example: I felt a little queasy this morning.
cards.exampleZh: 我今天早上有點想吐。

cards.example: Standing up too fast made me dizzy.
cards.exampleZh: 站太快讓我頭暈。

cards.example: The water gets choppy in the afternoon.
cards.exampleZh: 下午海面會變得波濤起伏。

cards.example: I got a nasty sunburn on my shoulders.
cards.exampleZh: 我肩膀曬傷得很嚴重。

cards.example: Reapply sunscreen every couple of hours.
cards.exampleZh: 每兩個小時要補擦防曬乳。

cards.example: Drink water — it's easy to get dehydrated here.
cards.exampleZh: 多喝水,這裡很容易脫水。

cards.example: There's a first aid station near the pool.
cards.exampleZh: 泳池附近有急救站。

cards.example: Is there a pharmacy on board?
cards.exampleZh: 船上有藥局嗎?

cards.example: I took a painkiller for my headache.
cards.exampleZh: 我吃了止痛藥治頭痛。

cards.example: In an emergency, head to your muster station.
cards.exampleZh: 發生緊急狀況時,前往你的集合站。

cards.example: Keep your medication in your carry-on.
cards.exampleZh: 把藥放在隨身行李裡。

cards.example: Attach the luggage tag before you drop it off.
cards.exampleZh: 寄放前先把行李吊牌綁上。

cards.example: A fanny pack is honestly convenient for travel.
cards.exampleZh: 腰包旅行時其實很方便。

cards.example: I just brought a small backpack.
cards.exampleZh: 我只帶了一個小後背包。

cards.example: Packing cubes keep my suitcase organized.
cards.exampleZh: 收納袋讓我的行李箱整齊很多。

cards.example: My power bank died halfway through the day.
cards.exampleZh: 我的行動電源到一半就沒電了。

cards.example: I left my charger in the cabin.
cards.exampleZh: 我把充電器忘在艙房裡了。

cards.example: Bring earplugs if you're a light sleeper.
cards.exampleZh: 淺眠的話記得帶耳塞。

cards.example: Flip-flops are fine for the pool deck.
cards.exampleZh: 泳池甲板穿夾腳拖就行。

cards.example: Don't forget to pack a swimsuit.
cards.exampleZh: 別忘了帶泳衣。

cards.example: It gets windy up top — bring a windbreaker.
cards.exampleZh: 上面風很大,帶件防風外套。

cards.example: Put dirty clothes in the laundry bag.
cards.exampleZh: 把髒衣服放進洗衣袋。

cards.example: I keep my toiletries in a clear pouch.
cards.exampleZh: 我把盥洗用品裝在透明袋裡。

cards.example: You'll want insect repellent for the jungle tour.
cards.exampleZh: 叢林行程會需要防蚊液。

cards.example: Refill your water bottle before heading out.
cards.exampleZh: 出門前把水壺裝滿。

cards.example: Take an umbrella just in case.
cards.exampleZh: 以防萬一帶把傘。

cards.example: I sat on my sunglasses. Again.
cards.exampleZh: 我又坐到我的太陽眼鏡了。

cards.example: Keep everything in one passport holder.
cards.exampleZh: 把東西都放在一個護照套裡。

cards.example: A neck pillow makes long flights bearable.
cards.exampleZh: 頸枕讓長途飛行沒那麼難熬。

cards.example: Put your phone in a dry bag for the boat ride.
cards.exampleZh: 搭船時把手機放進防水袋。

cards.example: I'm terrible at small talk with strangers.
cards.exampleZh: 我很不擅長跟陌生人閒聊。

cards.example: We hung out by the pool all afternoon.
cards.exampleZh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊消磨時間。

cards.example: Dinner at eight? Count me in.
cards.exampleZh: 八點吃晚餐?算我一份。

cards.example: Snorkeling tomorrow? I'm in.
cards.exampleZh: 明天去浮潛?我加入。

cards.example: Karaoke? I'll pass, thanks.
cards.exampleZh: 卡拉OK?我就不了,謝謝。

cards.example: I'm beat — let's call it a night.
cards.exampleZh: 我累爆了,今晚就到這吧。

cards.example: I'm beat after walking all day.
cards.exampleZh: 走了一整天我累壞了。

cards.example: We ran into our neighbors on deck.
cards.exampleZh: 我們在甲板上巧遇鄰居。

cards.example: Drop by our cabin if you're bored.
cards.exampleZh: 無聊的話順道來我們艙房。

cards.example: Let's catch up over coffee tomorrow.
cards.exampleZh: 明天喝咖啡聊聊近況吧。

cards.example: No worries, we've got plenty of time.
cards.exampleZh: 別擔心,我們時間還很多。

cards.example: Fair enough, let's do it your way.
cards.exampleZh: 有道理,就照你的方式吧。

cards.example: Suit yourself, but you'll miss the sunset.
cards.exampleZh: 隨你便,但你會錯過日落。

cards.example: More wine? I'm good, thanks.
cards.exampleZh: 還要酒嗎?我不用了,謝謝。

cards.example: Meet at six? Sounds good.
cards.exampleZh: 六點碰面?聽起來不錯。

cards.example: Hey, what's up? You look tired.
cards.exampleZh: 嘿,怎麼了?你看起來很累。

cards.example: Never mind, I found it.
cards.exampleZh: 算了,我找到了。

cards.example: Hold on, I forgot my keycard.
cards.exampleZh: 等一下,我忘了拿房卡。

cards.example: We should head back to the ship.
cards.exampleZh: 我們該回船上了。

cards.example: You've got to check out the view from deck fifteen.
cards.exampleZh: 你一定要去看看十五樓甲板的景色。

cards.example: We'll figure out dinner later.
cards.exampleZh: 晚餐的事我們晚點再想辦法。

cards.example: We ended up staying an extra hour.
cards.exampleZh: 我們最後多待了一小時。

cards.example: I never got around to using the gym.
cards.exampleZh: 我一直沒抽空去健身房。

cards.example: I'm looking forward to the last night's show.
cards.exampleZh: 我很期待最後一晚的表演。

cards.example: I can't put up with that noise anymore.
cards.exampleZh: 我再也受不了那個噪音了。
